## Supplied and omitted context / accountability
The complete plan, proposed seven-action row, coverage, requests, negative expected outcome, role/validation ledger, selections, canonical size measurements, all30 raw-parent identities, route preimage,55-site inventory and41 derivative metric summaries are supplied. Python data-only measurements are proposals, not executed schema/behavior evidence. The existing observe helper is complete; two observer excerpts are intentionally partial activation/completion gates, while complete current composition is supplied. Full old row objects (roughly790KB), full mutated manifests, remaining old observer body-oracle branches, generic runner execution/evaluator implementation beyond supplied boundaries, referenced scalar/result-entry schema definitions, full resource evaluator and full receipt/Event renderer are omitted for size. Their file hashes are pinned where part of source binding; omissions are not evidence they are absent. Schema objects supplied are complete objects, not selected fields, but their external $refs remain dependencies. The standalone principal oracle block supplies exact private Event projection and complete actual-response expectations as implementation precedent, not normative ID syntax or new execution evidence.

Review this distinction: existing manifest assertions alone do not perform new dynamic full-receipt/revision equality; the planned in-memory app observer must validate initial facts before baselines, drive both whole-JSON comparisons from a literal ledger and prove completion. Ref-based auth is separately covered by the existing executor, and actual serving identity belongs to each newly bootstrapped credential configuration. No arbitrary capture/body report recovery is allowed. All old raw row hashes and immediate-parent reconstructions must remain exact. Costs are source models whose historical runtime estimate is not guaranteed remaining CI capacity. Do not assume the plan's conclusions merely because prior tests passed; identify any flaw in their use for this exact integration. Requests for a missing excerpt should name the relevant invariant rather than report an invented code defect.
